intro: In eastern Elwynn, Torn Murloc Fins show the Stormwind Army's bounty is being answered. Taken from foragers and lurkers along the riverbanks, they show that local waterways are being systematically cleared.

p: Murlocs have grown numerous along eastern Elwynn's streams and lakes, and the Stormwind Army offers a bounty to reduce their numbers. Guard Thomas, who watches the bridge over the eastern river, collects the severed fins as proof of kills. Stormwind's soldiers are stretched thin by unrest at home and threats nearby, so local authorities depend on travelers to bring proof that murloc camps have been cleared.
